items.t: Said the legislature should obey the Constitution and the freedom to make your own healthcare choices.
items.q: The legislature should obey the Constitution and the freedom to make your own healthcare choices. Instead we keep making it harder to keep doctors in Wyoming and kids in this state,

items.t: Voted against a budget bill amendment that would have defunded gender studies at the University of Wyoming.
items.q: The same members just voted against an amendment to the budget bill that would have defunded gender studies at the University of Wyoming.

items.t: Said a compromise was made because several senior people worried about being disenfranchised, so one type of ID was included.
items.q: The only reason it passed was because there was a compromise made because there were several senior folks who were worried they were going to get disenfranchised. So, we stuck in this one sort of ID,

record.t: Voted against the "What Is a Woman Act" (HB 50) as a committee member.
record.q: Three Republican committee members who voted down the parental rights bill — Forrest Chadwick, Dan Zwonitzer, and Mike Yin — also voted against the “What Is a Woman Act.”
